# NHA Mini Desk

NHA Mini Desk is an open-source browser tool that turns a rough ask, message,
case, or client context into structured AI prompts for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude,
or any AI tool.

Live demo: https://www.ashishpunj.com/nha-tce/

Repository purpose:

- teach better prompting through a simple TCE + NHA workflow
- keep missing information visible
- encourage human verification before trusting AI output
- work without login, backend, API key, or database

Important files:

- README.md: project overview
- index.html: main app
- info.html: simple terms and privacy explanation
- app.js: translations, examples, and prompt generation logic
- style.css: visual design
- LICENSE: MIT License
